comparison.objective: Move a granite mortar and leave its loose pestle contained inside; candidate screens media from metal washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Heavy vessel transport and placement while managing one loose rigid object versus pouring many bodies and selectively passing media through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Mortar upright in target, pestle geometrically contained, both stable and robot clear; candidate requires media to leave the screen while every washer remains.
comparison.reason: Shared containment is generic; the mortar task preserves all objects together and has no separation or flow requirement.
